description: A full-featured package manager and viewer for Android

latest_release.name: App Manager v4.1.1
latest_release.body:
App Manager v4.1.1 improves permissions, installation, ADB connectivity, and several other parts of the application. Visit Settings > About > Version/Changelog for details.

**Revoke Internet Permission**
App Manager can now block internet for individual applications utilizing the eBPF rules in root or ADB mode. To block internet for an application, go to the "Uses permissions" tab and click on the toggle button next to `android.permission.INTERNET` to revoke the permission.
  
_Known Limitation._ The eBPF rules are lost after a reboot. App Manager attempts to restore the rules right after a reboot. However, in ADB mode, it might take a while to connect to wireless debugging depending on the availability of a Wi-Fi connection. This might allow applications that start after a reboot to use internet.  

**Others**
- Added support for editing `.bat` files  
- Improved installation reliability and performance  
- Improved permission management  
- Improved ADB pairing, connections, and mode handling  
- Improved settings transitions and startup messages  
- Fixed displaying profiles after creating a profile for the first time  
- Fixed intercepting browser URLs  
- Fixed listing applications on Android 17  
- Fixed title ordering in What's New dialog.  

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MuntashirAkon/AppManager/compare/v4.1.0...v4.1.1

detail.readme_excerpt:
App Manager

Docs · Releases · Telegram Channel

--- ## Features ### General features - Fully reproducible, copylefted libre software (GPLv3+) - Material 3 with dynamic colours - Display as much information as possible in the main page - List activities, broadcast receivers, services, providers, app ops, permissions, signatures, shared libraries, etc. of an application - Launch activities and services - Create shortcuts of activities - [Intercept activities](https://muntashirakon.github.io/AppManager/#sec:interceptor-page) - Scan for trackers and libraries in apps and list (all or only) tracking classes (and their code dump) - View/save the manifest of an app - Display app usage, data usage (mobile and Wi-Fi), and app storage info (requires “Usage Access” permission) - Install/uninstall APK files (including APKS, APKM and XAPK with OBB files) - Share APK files - Back up/restore APK files - Batch operations - Single-click operations - Logcat viewer, manager and exporter - [Profiles](https://muntashirakon.github.io/AppManager/#sec:profiles-page) - Debloater - Code editor - File manager - Simple terminal emulator - Open an app in Aurora Store or in your favourite F-Droid client - Sign APK files with custom signatures before installing - Backup encryption: OpenPGP via OpenKeychain, RSA, ECC (hybrid encryption with AES) and AES. - Track foreground UI components ### Root/ADB-only features - Revoke runtime (AKA dangerous) and development permissions - Change the mode of an app op - Display/kill/force-stop running apps or processes - Clear app data or app cache - View/change net policy - Control battery optimization - Freeze/unfreeze apps ### Root-only features - Block any activities, broadcast receivers, services, or providers of an app with native import/export as well as Watt and Blocker import support - View/edit/delete shared preferences of any app - Back up/restore apps with data, rules and extras (such as permissions, battery optimization, SSAID, etc.) - View system configurations including blacklisted or whitelisted apps, permissions, etc. - View/change SSAID. …and many more! This single app combines the features of 5 or 6 apps any tech-savvy person needs! ### Upcoming features - Finder: Find app components, permissions etc. in all apps - Basic APK editing - Routine operations - Enable/disable app actions such as launch on boot - Crash monitor - Systemless disabling/uninstalling of the system apps - Import app list exported by App Manager - More advance terminal emulator - Database viewer and editor, etc. [
